description: Get a verified bullion dealer's public profile, stored shipping-policy summary, current catalog size, and newest/oldest current-offer timestamps. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

dealerId.description: Dealer ID or slug (e.g., 'jm-bullion', 'JM Bullion', or 'jmbullion.com').

name: get_dealer_profile
